description: Pull a CPF Mortgage home value report for a U.S. residential property: estimated value with low/high range and confidence, property facts, last sale, recent comparable sales, rent estimate with rental comparables, 3-year market forecast, and a link to the full branded PDF. Reports already pulled in the last 14 days return instantly.

address.description: Full property address including street number, city, state and 5-digit ZIP, e.g. "512 Wideview Ave, Tarpon Springs, FL 34689". Include the unit for condos.

name: get_home_value_report

choices.description: Matching addresses when status is ambiguous

pdf_url.description: Signed link to the full CPF-branded PDF, valid for 7 days

status.description: ready, processing, ambiguous, not_found, needs_address, daily_limit, rate_limited or failed

title: Get home value report
